arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E23 The Career Day Episode Nick confuses Kevin's classmates when he implies that networking is more important than studying and getting good grades.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E24 The Good Cop, Bad Cop Episode Suzanne is tired of being the bad cop while Nick plays the good cop with the kids, so they decide to switch places.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E51 The Hand on a House Episode Lindsey and Kevin enter Nick into a Hand on a House contest, where finalists compete by seeing who can keep their hand on a house for the longest.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E01 The Mr. Himdependent Episode When Suzanne's ex-husband wants to lower his monthly child support payments, Nick jumps at the chance while Suzanne has mixed feelings about Frank abandoning his own responsibilities.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E07 The Suzanne Theft Auto Episode Suzanne becomes overly consumed with Kevin's science project; Lindsey revs up for driving lessons, only to emerge as a suspect when her mother's car is scratched.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E13 The Whose Card Is It Anyway Episode Suzanne and Nick go on a "People's Court TV" show when Nick lies about having spent a gift card Suzanne gave him, which she finds and spends on herself, calling him on his lie.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E52 The Spelling Bee Episode Nick meets a famous actor and shadows him to prepare for an upcoming role; Kevin studies for a spelling bee.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E18 The Pole Dance Episode Suzanne catches Nick watching a rap video with a pole dancer in it and decides to show him that she is the best pole dancer on the block.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E12 The Parent Teacher Trap Episode When Suzanne gets roped into a committee at Kevin's school, where the other mums are mean to her, Nick volunteers to fill in on her behalf, making things awkward when the ladies love him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E26 The Play Date Episode Suzanne and Nick go out with another couple, her friend Danielle and husband Steve; the double date soon fizzles when an accusation flies.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E30 The Silent Treatment Episode Nick and Suzanne stop talking to each other after Suzanne gets upset with Nick for his attempts to fix her problems without listening to her.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E19 The Tit for Tat Episode When a new woman gets hired at the station, Nick's career is threatened; Suzanne takes matters into her own hands to save her husband's job.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E56 The Identity Theft Episode Nick's identity is stolen; Suzanne takes a week off to attend a wedding; Marilyn shares a life lesson.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S01 E02 The Credit Check Episode Nick needs a new van for work, but Suzanne worries they are already too much in debt and cannot afford to buy a new one; Suzanne has some credit issues she has not revealed to Nick.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E20 The Salsa Episode Annoyed that she and Nick never do anything together as a couple, Suzanne signs the two of them up for salsa lessons, but is surprised by her control issues on the dance floor.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E27 The Family Portrait Episode Suzanne wants to have a formal portrait of the family taken, but trying to pull everyone together proves to be impossible.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E22 The Test Taker Episode Kevin assists Frankie in preparing for an exam, but Frankie offers a bribe to persuade Kevin to take the test on his behalf.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E03 The Oh No She Di-in't Episode When Nick's new field producer, Sam, turns out to be female, Suzanne is convinced she is trying to steal her man, a suggestion Nick thinks is absurd until Sam actually makes a move on him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E28 The Liar, Liar Episode Suzanne begins to force everyone in the family to tell the truth at all times after she catches Nick in a lie.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E47 The Wrong Way Episode Nick hesitantly attends his high school reunion, but all of his fears come true when his high school nickname haunts him throughout the event; Lindsey prepares a feast.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E12 The Tiger Dad Episode Nick becomes a more influential parent, so he pushes Kevin and Lindsey hard, and they become model children.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E30 The Nick's Kid Episode Suzanne learns the mother of Kevin's new friend Nathan is Nick's old fling; she suspects that Nathan could be Nick's son.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E05 The Boy Has Style Episode Suzanne suspects that Lindsey's athletic new crush from school is gay; Nick sets out to prove that he is not in order to save Lindsey from facing disappointment.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S02 E31 The Kevin Gets a Commercial Episode Kevin auditions for a commercial for the mall burger joint and ends up being replaced by a famous kid actor that looks just like him.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E17 The Lemon Squeeze Episode When the family's morning routine devolves into fighting, Gigi suggests that they try an old sorority exercise called the Lemon Squeeze in order to turn their problems around.

arewethereyet.us.title: Are We There Yet?
arewethereyet.us.description: S03 E14 The Master of Ceremonies Episode While hosting an awards ceremony, Nick gets laughs by making Suzanne the butt of his jokes, but finds he cannot stand the heat when Suzanne turns the tables and starts making fun of him in public.

combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E21 The Fall Will Kill You The final battle of the war begins as Russian forces advance rapidly into Berlin, smashing its defenders back towards an ever-shrinking last stand.

combatwarchannel.us.title: WWII In Color: From D-Day to Nazi Downfall
combatwarchannel.us.description: S01 E17 The River Crossing The great rivers of the Rhineland along Germany's western border must be crossed to take the fight to the enemy's home turf.

(Reality, Law) - 2023-03-21

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Hoodlum
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: In New York of the 1920s, three rival gang leaders (Laurence Fishhburne, Tim Roth and Andy Garcia) battle for control of Harlem's urban power.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Fled
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Two prison escapees on the lam race against time to find a hidden cache of cash and an incriminating computer disk.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Kalifornia
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: A couple (David Duchovny, Michelle Forbes) sets out on a cross-country trip to research a book about serial killers and, along the way, pick up an ex-con and his girlfriend (Brad Pitt, Juliette Lewis) who take them on a ride they'll never forget.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: No Way Out
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: The Package
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Red Corner
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: In this provocative thriller, an American (Richard Gere) on a business trip in China is framed for a brutal murder and soon finds himself at the mercy of a foreign court system he doesn't understand. Can he find the true killer before it's too late?

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: State Of Grace
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: An undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: The Hot Spot
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: A drifter (Don Johnson) moves into a small town and into a torrid affair with a local woman (Virginia Madsen). But when he falls in love with someone else (Jennifer Connelly), he finds himself trapped in a dangerous web of revenge and murder!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Chrome And Hot Leather
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Enraged when a biker gang kills his fiancée (Cheryl Ladd), a Green Beret (Tony Young) declares war and discovers that revenge is a dish best served...with a rocket launcher! Also stars William Smith, Marvin Gaye, Peter Brown and Michael Sterns.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Yongary: Monster From The Deep
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: In South Korea's first entry into the kaiju genre, a monstrous creature creates destruction throughout Korea as scientists race against time to create a refrigerant that may be the only weapon to stop the monster before it destroys the country!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Tentacles
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: It's angry, hungry, well-armed and ready to sample the local cuisine! John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda star in this gripping thriller!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Leviathan
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: In this sci-fi thriller, Peter Weller leads an exploration team trapped five miles beneath the ocean's surface with a creature that cannot die!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre 2
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) seeks to avenge the murder of his kin by Leatherface, Chop-Top, The Cook and Grandpa. With the help of a radio DJ he finds his way to their underground slaughter shop, where a battle of epic proportions will soon rage.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Burning
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Gather around the campfire....to die! After a cruel joke severely disfigures him, camp caretaker Cropsy is back -- with hedge clippers in hand -- seeking revenge on those who scarred him! Can the campers save themselves before he kills them all?

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Sleepaway Camp II: Unhappy Campers
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Five years after the massacre at Camp Arawak, Angela is now working at Camp Rolling Hills. She's still crazy...for camping and good clean fun, that is. But Angela draws the line at bad behavior and she's going to teach some naughty campers a lesson!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Sleepaway Camp III: Teenage Wasteland
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Under inept new management, Camp Rolling Hills is now Camp New Horizons and it's the ideal setting for a notorious psychopath like Angela Baker to do what she does best, eliminating "immoral" teenagers with everything from a knife to a lawnmower.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: To All A Good Night
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: The Calvin Finishing School for Girls is closed for Christmas vacation. However, Mrs. Jensen (the housemother), five teenage girls and their mischievous male companions are all that remain at the school...or are they?

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: New Year's Evil
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: This New Year's, you're invited to a killer party...While the host of a punk-rock TV show is broadcasting live, she begins receiving calls on-air from a psychopath who's planning to kill a "naughty girl" as midnight strikes in each U.S. time zone!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Horror Show
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: A maniacal murderer (Brion James) returns from the depths of hell to seek revenge on the cop who captured him in this supernatural horror-fest!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Video Dead
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: On a quiet, tree-lined street, evil has arrived through an old television set when killer zombies crawl out of a horror film and into suburbia!

mgmpresentshorror.us.description: When an evil troll attempts to forever erase mankind, a sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his plan.

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: America's Conspiracy Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: Some people think everything is a conspiracy. Luckily for them, the FBI declassified decades' worth of government documents in April 2011, allowing people to gain more insight behind some of the most popular conspiracy theories. Each episode of this series investigates a compelling theory by opening these and other files. After acquiring new information, the show's team of specialists re-examines faulty assumptions, looks for inconsistencies and explores new leads in an attempt to get to the bottom of each case. Just make sure you have your tin foil handy when watching the show. (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

outlaw.us.title: Gunfight at Comanche Creek
outlaw.us.description: In 1875, a band of brutal bandits craft a dastardly scheme. First they bust a convicted man out of jail, and then they force him to commit a string of robberies to increase the price on his head. Finally, they murder him and collect the bounty. Lawman Bob Gifford (Audie Murphy) is onto their vicious plan, and he goes undercover as a prisoner to lure in these savage villains. But he struggles to stay focused after crossing paths with a sweet saloon owner (Colleen Miller). (Western) - 1963

outlaw.us.title: The Cheyenne Social Club
outlaw.us.description: Cowboy John O'Hanlan (James Stewart) is surprised to learn that someone's left him a business in Cheyenne, Wyo. He sets out to claim it -- and is shocked to discover that it's a brothel. Madam Jenny (Shirley Jones), who runs the place, is dismayed when O'Hanlan wants to close it down, but his plans are derailed when he finds out that a local customer has beaten Jenny. He kills the man in a shootout, and then must protect himself and the girls from the dead man's vengeful clan. (Western, Comedy) - 1970

outlaw.us.title: A Big Hand for the Little Lady
outlaw.us.description: When a yearly high-stakes poker game begins between the five richest men in Laredo, Texas, all other activity in the Wild West town comes to a stop as everyone gathers to watch the action. Recovering gambler Meredith (Henry Fonda), passing through town on the way to San Antonio, gets roped into the game by lawyer Otto Habershaw (Kevin McCarthy). When the stress of the game becomes too much to bear, his disapproving wife, Mary (Joanne Woodward), must step in to save the family fortune. (Western, Comedy) - 1966

outlaw.us.title: The Avenging Angel
outlaw.us.description: An orphan grows up to fulfill his duty as bodyguard (Tom Berenger) to Mormon leader Brigham Young (Charlton Heston). (Historical drama) - 1995

outlaw.us.title: One-Eyed Jacks
outlaw.us.description: After pulling a bank heist in Mexico, the outlaw Rio (Marlon Brando) and his partner, Dad Longworth (Karl Malden), make a run for it, but Dad has bigger plans than freedom. He betrays Rio and absconds with the loot, and Rio ends up in prison. Years pass before Rio finally breaks free to enact his long-plotted revenge. Tracking Dad to California, Rio learns he's become a sheriff -- which is no deterrent -- but when Rio falls for Dad's stepdaughter, Louisa (Pina Pellicer), he has second thoughts. (Western, Drama) - 1961

outlaw.us.title: Allegheny Uprising
outlaw.us.description: In Colonial America, Jim Smith (John Wayne) leads a group, including the intense Janie MacDougall (Claire Trevor), that tries to figure out who is supplying the area Native American tribes with weapons. He suspects corrupt trader Ralph Callendar (Brian Donlevy), but does not have proof yet. Jim's accusations fall on deaf ears with unsympathetic British commander Capt. Swanson (George Sanders). Worse, Callendar, sensing that Jim is on to him, frames the hero for murder. (Adventure) - 1939

outlaw.us.title: Ride Him, Cowboy
outlaw.us.description: After a group of outlaws vandalizes a ranch and injures a ranch hand, their leader, Sims (Frank Hagney), blames a horse named Duke. As the townspeople prepare to execute Duke, John Drury (John Wayne) negotiates a pardon for the animal. Sims, who is in reality a famed killer known as the Hawk, attempts to eliminate John and frame him for a ranch fire. As the angry townspeople search for John, he must prove his innocence and stop the Hawk once and for all. (Western) - 1932

outlaw.us.title: Texas Terror
outlaw.us.description: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors. (Western) - 1935

outlaw.us.title: The Painted Hills
outlaw.us.description: A determined prospector, Jonathan Harvey (Paul Kelly) finds gold after years of searching. When he returns to town to tell his partner, Jonathan finds that his friend has died, leaving his son, Tommy (Gary Gray), on his own. While Jonathan's loyal collie, Lassie, stays with the boy, he goes to find help to assist him with his lucrative discovery. However, the new recruit (Bruce Cowling) proves to be a shady character, and before long the ruthless schemer has incurred the wrath of Lassie. (Adventure) - 1951

outtvproud.us.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
outtvproud.us.description: Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy. (Romantic comedy, Drama) - 2007

outtvproud.us.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2

This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita Stretch Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park. outtvproud.us.title: Repo! The Genetic Opera

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Aerial America
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S01E53 Iowa A sky-high tour over Iowa explores its vast stretches of farmland, covered bridges and evolution from wilderness to statehood. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Nature)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E01 Flight of the Grizzly An orphaned bear cub flies to a new home, Bush pilots bring life-saving medical machinery to a remote village; record snowfall threatens to close down Anchorage airport for Thanksgiving and the U.S. Army prepares for airborne warfare in the Arctic. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E02 Mountain Sheep, Pizza Pie A breakdown on the Fairbanks runway threatens a heavy-weight military jet's urgent mission; a rookie flight instructor faces a make-or-break flight; an ice-tour pilot races against Alaskan weather; a bush airline flies a 400-mile pizza delivery. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E03 The Flight Before Christmas A major snowstorm disrupts Christmas travel in Anchorage; bush pilots aid an Arctic village after a fire; ice jeopardizes an airborne science mission; Customs agents combat a surge in illegal holiday food imports. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E04 Shivering Timbers A Coast Guard chopper pilot battles winds in a mission that will decide her flying career; a mountain construction project gets an express aerial delivery of materials in Alaska-style; two bald eagles hitch a first-class ride. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E05 Flight to Glory A trainee chopper pilot tackles a midair engine shutdown; Bush pilots face a high-altitude test on an aerial grocery run; the US Army in Alaska launch their biggest helicopter deployment ever, and an Arctic-sports phenom flies high to win gold. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E06 Avalanche Warning Scientists fly to save Anchorage from avalanche destruction; border agents stop a potential insect invasion at Anchorage International; a bush pilot flies explosive cargo for a village festival, and the Coast Guard races to repair. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska
smithsonianchannelwest.us.description: S05E07 The Big Chill Shiver as a DC-6 crew delivers medicine in fuel-freezing weather, then cheer on a rookie Coast Guard rescue swimmer during a crucial test; battle a tourist-season-ending engine fault and hunker down as a blizzard closes in on two vital airports. (Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

(Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska

(Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska

(Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska

(Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska

(Episode, Series, Documentary, Aviation)

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska

smithsonianchannelwest.us.title: Ice Airport Alaska

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional : Semifinals - UVA vs. JMU
pickletv.us.description: S2024 E17 The University of Virginia (UVA) and James Madison University (JMU) ignite an intense intrastate rivalry in a semifinal clash at the 2024 DUPR Virginia Beach Super Regional. UVA enters the arena as a statistical powerhouse, led by former national champion Alexandra McDonald, whose dominant drives in Women's Doubles put the JMU Dukes under immediate pressure. The intensity remains high as the competition moves into Men's Doubles, where the Burns brothers for UVA face off against JMU’s Ryan Morneau and Carter Work in a high-stakes battle for a spot in the championship final.

pickletv.us.title: NPL : 2024 NPL – Women’s Team Match – Scorpions vs Iconics
pickletv.us.description: S24 E24 The Coachella Valley Scorpions take on the Denver Iconics in a thrilling women’s National Pickleball League showdown from the 2024 season. From powerful baseline drives to lightning-fast net battles, both teams bring competitive spirit and polished teamwork to the court. Whether you're a seasoned fan or new to the NPL, this match showcases the rising talent and intensity of women’s pro pickleball. Every point matters — and momentum can shift in a flash.

pickletv.us.title: Breaking Pickleball : S01E02 - Scottsdale Scorchers
pickletv.us.description: S1 E2 Meet Caden Nemoff and the Scottsdale Scorchers.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Rajasthan vs. Hyderabad - Day 2 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2 E4 Experience the tactical intensity of the World Pickleball League as the Rajasthan Titans look to mount a comeback against the surging Hyderabad Superstars. This episode spotlights a generational clash in the men's singles match between Rajasthan’s Jack Foster and Hyderabad’s Marcelo Jardim, a 51-year-old former world No. 3 in padel and a true legend of racquet sports.

pickletv.us.title: All Florida Pro League : AFPL Stop 4 Championship Court - Game 2 - Jacksonville Ballers vs. Fort Myers Flamingos
pickletv.us.description: S1 E3 Commentators provide an inside look at Game 2 of the All Florida Pro League (AFPL) Stop 4 in Sarasota, Florida. The Fort Myers Flamingos get off to a dominant start, but the Jacksonville Ballers refuse to give up, staging a dramatic late-game comeback that tightens the score and mounts the pressure. This episode features key players like Stevie, Sophia Dorsey, and Maddalena, with highlights of their strategic plays and powerful shots. Tune in to see if the Flamingos can hold on to their lead and close out the game against the surging Ballers.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2025 - Delhi vs. Mumbai Day 2 Tie 2
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E4 The action continues on Day 2 of the World Pickleball League (WPL) with the highly anticipated second matchup: Delhi takes on Mumbai Pickle Power at the CCI Brabourne Stadium in Mumbai.This matchup features a spectacular lineup, including Delhi's players Alexa Schule, Eduardo Irizarry, and Willie Chung, against a strong Mumbai squad that includes Brandon Lane, Glauca Lane, and Kim Ngo.

pickletv.us.title: Tuesday Night Pickleball : - January 3 2023 - All Stars Mixed Doubles
pickletv.us.description: S1 E6 January 3, 2023 - Live from The Orchard @ Jigsaw Health, it's Tuesday Night Pickleball.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 : US Open 2024 – Women’s Split Pro Doubles Semifinal – Courter & Humberg vs Frantova & Karges
pickletv.us.description: S1 E12 Sheri Courter and Mari Humberg take on Martina Frantova and Christine Karges in this Women’s Split Pro Doubles Semifinal match at the 2024 US Open Pickleball Championships. With fast-paced exchanges, sharp angles, and tactical precision, both teams battle for a spot in the finals on the prestigious Zing Zang Championship Court in Naples, Florida. This high-stakes match features standout teamwork and thrilling rallies from some of the sport’s most skilled competitors.

pickletv.us.title: Picklebowl 2022 : - Men's Doubles 4
pickletv.us.description: S1 E4 Heisman Trophy winning quarterback Danny Wuerffel & Pickleball pro Kyle Yates compete against US Olympian Casey Patterson & Pickleball pro Chuck Taylor in the final game of Picklebowl 2022.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA 2026 - University of Virginia Cavaliers vs. University of Central Florida Knights
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E3 Witness a classic ACC vs. Big 12 showdown at the Arch Pickleball Center as the Virginia Cavaliers and UCF Knights battle through a grueling series that pushes both teams to the brink. The Racing pace of the "firefights" at the net keeps spectators on edge as both sides trade rapid-fire volleys in a test of pure reaction time. Technical Skills are on full display with precision dinks and rare "Bert" shots that highlight the high-level strategy required for collegiate dominance. In a Freestyle display of grit and determination, the match culminates in a high-voltage sudden death round where every shot determines who will advance in the national bracket.

pickletv.us.title: World Pickleball League (WPBL) : WPBL 2026 - Rajasthan vs Chennai - Day 4 Tie 1
pickletv.us.description: S2 E7 The World Pickleball League Season 2 continues at the Jio World Garden in Mumbai with a critical Day 4 clash between the Rajasthan Titans and the league-leading Chennai Super Champs. Entering the tie as heavy favorites, coach Johnny Goldberg’s Chennai squad looks to solidify their top spot on the leaderboard. Meanwhile, the Rajasthan Titans, led by coach Leigh Whitwell, are desperate to find their rhythm and climb the points table after a challenging start to the season.

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate Pickleball Tour : Women's Singles Final - Indiana vs. Clemson
pickletv.us.description: S2024 E1 Indiana’s Safdar faces Clemson’s Bozzetto in the 2024 DUPR National Championship Women’s Singles Final, battling for collegiate pickleball supremacy in a best-of-three format.

pickletv.us.title: Pickleball England : English Nationals 2023 – Men’s Doubles Open Group A Match 1 – Wren & Woolf vs Malbois & Rospo
pickletv.us.description: S1 E1 Live from Bolton Arena in Greater Manchester, this Group A match at the English Nationals 2023 features Daniel Wren and Alex Woolf squaring off against Sebastien Malbois and Roberto Rospo. The teams bring a mix of controlled setups, powerful drives, and smart resets as they battle for an early advantage in the tournament.Expect sharp exchanges at the kitchen, tactical stacking, and impressive shot-making as both sides fight for momentum in this fast-paced men’s doubles opener.

pickletv.us.title: All Florida Pro League : Jacksonville Ballers vs Miami Blaze
pickletv.us.description: S1 E21 Jacksonville Ballers versus Miami Blaze match. Both teams winning their first match. Discussion on Blaze's surprise win and strategies.

pickletv.us.title: Pickleball England : English Open 2023 – Mixed Doubles Open 5.0+ Final – DeHeart & Fudge vs Petterson & Barr
pickletv.us.description: S1 E12 The 2023 English Open Mixed Doubles Open 5.0+ Final brings serious heat as Ryler DeHeart and Megan Fudge square off against Nick Petterson and Susannah Barr. This final showcases elite shot-making, smart stacking strategies, and seamless teamwork from both sides of the net.With momentum shifting and nerves running high, every rally counts. From laser-focused drives to perfectly timed poaches, this match is a clinic in competitive mixed doubles and a thrilling conclusion to the Open division.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA Utah Regional 2025 - Utah Valley vs. Utah Tech
pickletv.us.description: S2025 E10 The grand finale of the 2025 NCPA Utah Regional Championship, the second of six regionals for the season. The rivalry matchup features the top teams from Utah Valley University and Utah Tech.This broadcast highlights the intense Men's Doubles game, where Utah Tech's star player Liam Duffin—hailed as one of the top collegiate players nationwide—teams up with Clayton Boydston to face Utah Valley's duo of Bryce Larson and Charles Case.The stakes are high: teams are competing for $5,000 in scholarship money and a coveted bid to the National Championship in St. Louis, Missouri, where $30,000 is on the line. Ultimately, Utah Tech's first team prevails, taking home the national bid and the Utah Regional title.

pickletv.us.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2024 : - Women's Pro Doubles - Semifinal
pickletv.us.description: S1 E35 Arielle Butler and Mari Humberg take on Simone Jardim and Allison Harris in this Women's Pro Doubles Semifinal Match.

pickletv.us.title: DUPR Collegiate Super Regional : Semifinals - Utah Valley vs. GCU
pickletv.us.description: S2024 E5 The DUPR Collegiate Pickleball Utah Super Regional semifinals deliver high-octane action as powerhouse Utah Valley University (UVU) goes head-to-head with Grand Canyon University (GCU). Watch as UVU's Sophia Thompson and Ali Evanson attempt to protect their undefeated record against GCU’s Brenna Murray and former BYU tennis star Dodo Kong in a hard-hitting women’s doubles opener. The intensity shifts to the men's doubles as UVU's Tyler Miller and Thatcher Schwendimann face a strategic challenge from GCU's Adam Jones and Artur Fonseca, a beach tennis specialist from Brazil. With a spot in the finals on the line, this match showcases elite collegiate talent, "body bag" shots, and the fierce school spirit that defines the DUPR circuit.

pickletv.us.title: NPL : Stingers vs Hotshots (Team Breaker)
pickletv.us.description: S24 E22 The Kansas City Stingers face off against the Columbus Hotshots in a mixed NPL team match.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA 2026 - University of South Florida vs. Kansas Jayhawks
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E8 The intensity reaches a boiling point in Saint Louis as the NCPA Nationals transition to a high-stakes, single-elimination "win or go home" format. The University of South Florida Bulls and the Kansas Jayhawks take center stage in a best-of-seven battle where every point feels like a "Racing" sprint toward the championship crown. Watch as Austin King and Tessa Wilson utilize elite "Skills" to navigate a narrow center court, fending off a late-game surge by the Jayhawks to secure a hard-fought 11-8 victory. With the bracket tightening and powerhouses like Penn State and Michigan looming, this "Freestyle" display of collegiate talent proves that in the world of elite pickleball, there is zero room for error.

retroplex.us.title: Battle Ground
retroplex.us.description: Three British soldiers become stranded in no man's land after a failed charge on German trenches. (War, Action, Drama) - 2013

retroplex.us.title: Double Whammy
retroplex.us.description: Ray Pluto (Denis Leary) has many problems. He is satirized in the tabloids as the "loser cop." His partner (Steve Buscemi) is starting to seem suspiciously attracted to him. A pair of screenwriters (Donald Faison, Keith Nobbs) across the hall keep bugging him for help. The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing. (Comedy) - 2001

retroplex.us.title: The Promise
retroplex.us.description: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. Their shared Armenian heritage sparks an attraction that explodes into a romantic rivalry between Michael and Ana's boyfriend (Christian Bale), an American photojournalist who's dedicated to exposing the truth. As the Ottoman Empire crumbles into war-torn chaos, their conflicting passions must be deferred as they join forces to get themselves and their people to safety. (Historical drama, Romance) - 2016

retroplex.us.title: Tucker: The Man and His Dream
retroplex.us.description: Obsessed with cars since childhood, inventor Preston Tucker (Jeff Bridges) has his first successful auto design partnership in the 1930s and designs a successful gun turret for World War II use. With those achievements under his belt, Tucker is determined to create a futuristic car for the masses: the Tucker Torpedo. However, his dreams are challenged by Detroit's auto manufacturers, production problems and accusations of stock fraud, and he is forced to defend his dream and honesty in court. (Biography, Historical drama) - 1988

retroplex.us.title: The Stranger
retroplex.us.description: Immediately following World War II, ex-Nazi Franz Kindler is living under a false identity as a teacher in a small Connecticut town, and has even married the headmaster's daughter as part of his cover. But when one of Kindler's old German associates arrives unexpectedly in town, bringing in his wake a sly federal investigator, Kindler resorts to desperate measures to preserve his secret. (Thriller) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Colorado
retroplex.us.description: Lieutenant Jerry Burke (Roy Rogers) is sent to Colorado to track down a troublesome gang. When he finally catches them, he finds out his traitorous brother commands them. (Western) - 1940

retroplex.us.title: The Carson City Kid
retroplex.us.description: The Carson City Kid (Roy Rogers) stops stagecoaches traveling between Wild West mining towns, searching their mail sacks for letters addressed to Morgan Reynolds, the man who killed his brother. Discovering that Reynolds operates a saloon under the name Lee Jessup (Bob Steele), the Kid takes a job as the saloon's bouncer. While vying with Reynolds for the affections of singer Joby Madison (Pauline Moore), the Kid discovers a swindled miner (Noah Beery Jr.) who claims to be the Carson City Kid. (Western) - 1940

retroplex.us.title: In Old Caliente
retroplex.us.description: In California, Roy (Roy Rogers) works on the large ranch of Don Jose (Frank Puglia), one of the last of the major Spanish landowners. The foreman of the ranch, Saguaro (Jack LaRue), is involved with a gang of bandits and hopes to pit the newly arriving Americans against the dwindling Spanish and native populations. Saguaro becomes Roy's nemesis, getting him banished from the ranch and framing him for various crimes, but Roy concocts an audacious plan to clear his name. (Western) - 1939

retroplex.us.title: Lights of Old Santa Fe
retroplex.us.description: In this musical western, Marjorie Brooks (Dale Evans) is the owner and operator of a rodeo that's an antiquated touring company on its last legs. Her business rival, Frank Madden (Richard Powers), offers to combine their operations if the lovely Marjorie will be his bride. Though she initially rebuffs his proposal, a canceled booking tips the scales and forces Marjorie to accept. But rodeo rider Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) suspects Frank is behind Marjorie's troubles and sets out to investigate. (Western) - 1944

retroplex.us.title: Stagecoach Outlaws
retroplex.us.description: Cowboy Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) enrages saloon owner Steve Kirby (Stanford Jolley) when he thwarts a bank robbery by Kirby's crew. But Kirby has more schemes up his sleeve. He sends his men to bust brutish outlaw Matt Brawley (Bob Kortman) out of jail for a new heist. When a case of mistaken identities leads to the bandits freeing harmless Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) instead, he decides to play along to help Billy. However, the real Brawley soon arrives to cause trouble. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Rimfire
retroplex.us.description: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: Lightning Raiders
retroplex.us.description: When his mail doesn't get delivered one day, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) is suspicious. He enlists the help of his friend Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) to find out what happened. The duo discovers that the postal stagecoach has been held up by Frank Hayden (Steve Darrell) and his band of thieves, and that the criminals are in hiding. It's up to Fuzzy and Billy to stop the thieves before they make off with the stolen mail -- and with the money and secrets that it contains. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Under California Stars
retroplex.us.description: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Don Ricardo Returns
retroplex.us.description: Two years after being forcibly taken away from his California property by thugs working for his greedy cousin, Luerra (Anthony Warde), Don Ricardo (Fred Coby) returns to reclaim his ranch and his fiancée, Dorothea (Isabelita). After meeting old friend Lugo the Huge (Paul Newlan) in a cantina, Don Ricardo takes the advice of Padre Carlos (David Leonard) and gets a job on his land, disguised as a common laborer, biding his time until he can find evidence of Luerra's wrongdoing and challenge him. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: The Stranger
retroplex.us.description: Immediately following World War II, ex-Nazi Franz Kindler is living under a false identity as a teacher in a small Connecticut town, and has even married the headmaster's daughter as part of his cover. retroplex.us.title: Shotgun

waypointtv.us.title: The WoodHaven Way

waypointtv.us.title: The Bearded Buck : Third Times A Charm

waypointtv.us.title: Hard Truths Of Conservation : Wild Harvest

waypointtv.us.title: Just Shot: Realtree Road Trips : Nebraska 2

waypointtv.us.title: Just Shot: Realtree Road Trips : Hunt for Dash

truehistory.us.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity - Oral and Written Traditions about Jesus
truehistory.us.description: How four anonymous authors who live decades after Jesus record traditions that have been circulating orally over the intervening years; examining the extent to which those traditions have been modified in the retelling. (Educational, History, Religious) - 2004-01-26

truehistory.us.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation - The Historical Study of Christianity
truehistory.us.description: The historical trajectory of Christianity; contemporary ignorance of its past; considering the value of the historical study of Christianity; looking at the methods and role of the historian; the sources and limitations of historical knowledge. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2012-11-17

truehistory.us.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation - The First Cultural Context - Greece and Rome
truehistory.us.description: Investigating the culture of the Mediterranean world in which Christianity is born; the legacy of Alexander; the features of Greek politics, religion and philosophy; learning about the nature of Roman rule and imperial order in the region. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2012-11-17

truehistory.us.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation - The First Cultural Context - Judaism
truehistory.us.description: The circumstances of Jewish life in ancient Palestine and the diaspora; examining cultural and ideological factors that divide the Jews; the tensions they face between assimilation and separation; their resistance to Greek culture and Roman rule. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2012-11-17

truehistory.us.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation - The Jesus Movement and the Birth of Christianity
truehistory.us.description: Considering the resurrection as marking the birth of Christianity, as rooted in the claims of the first believers; assessing the contradiction between Jesus as the source of divine life and the degrading manner of his death. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2012-11-17

truehistory.us.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation - Paul and Christianity's First Expansion
truehistory.us.description: Observing how Christianity's expansion happens; the broad adaptations it makes in a relatively short period; investigating the role of Paul's letters as a primary record of the convictions, culture, practices and troubles of the early Christians. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2012-11-17

truehistory.us.title: The History of Christianity: From the Disciples to the Dawn of the Reformation - The Diversity of Early Christianity
truehistory.us.description: Influences in early Christianity beyond Jesus and Paul; the differences in conviction and perspective in the gospels of Matthew, Mark, Luke and John; the four Gospels' interpretations of Jesus's role; their convergence on the nature of his character. (Educational, Religious, History) - 2012-11-17

truehistory.us.title: The Historical Jesus - The Many Faces of Jesus
truehistory.us.description: Scholars who have devoted their lives to studying the ancient sources about Jesus come to varying conclusions; seeing what can be learned about what Jesus most likely says and does by working from a strictly historical perspective. (Educational, Religious) - 2000-07-18

truehistory.us.title: The Historical Jesus - One Remarkable Life
truehistory.us.description: Beginning the study of the historical Jesus by examining the world within which the Christian religion is born; this world is largely populated by "pagans" who, unlike the Jews and then later the Christians, believe not in one but in many gods. (Educational, Religious) - 2000-07-18

truehistory.us.title: The Historical Jesus - Scholars Look at the Gospels
truehistory.us.description: The work of German writer D. F. Strauss argues that the Gospels are best understood as containing history-like stories that intend to convey truth but do not occur as they are narrated, which is why most scholars find his approach illuminating. (Educational, Religious) - 2000-07-18

truehistory.us.title: The Historical Jesus - Fact and Fiction in the Gospels
truehistory.us.description: Scholars question the historical accuracy of some gospel accounts not out of hostility toward Christianity, but because of historical evidence; what this evidence is; how historians assess it. (Educational, Religious) - 2000-07-18

truehistory.us.title: The Historical Jesus - The Birth of the Gospels
truehistory.us.description: Before the Gospels, accounts of Jesus are passed on by word of mouth; whether it is possible to move "behind" the written accounts to learn more about this original oral tradition, and perhaps even about Jesus himself as a historical person. (Educational, Religious) - 2000-07-18

truehistory.us.title: The Historical Jesus - Some of the Other Gospels
truehistory.us.description: In addition to the New Testament, other written sources about Jesus come down from antiquity; what these other, noncanonical Gospels are like; considering their origins and sources; how much they can reveal about what Jesus actually says and does. (Educational, Religious) - 2000-07-18

truehistory.us.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity - The Birth of Christianity

truehistory.us.title: From Jesus to Constantine: A History of Early Christianity - The Religious World of Early Christianity

classica.us.title: Hollywood Gala
classica.us.description: Der Schweizer Dirigent Ludwig Wicki leitet das Dänische nationale Sinfonieorchester und den DR Junior Chor in einem glanzvollen Konzertprogramm mit Filmmusik. Das Programm umfasst eine Auswahl an Musik aus den besten und Oscar-ausgezeichneten Hollywood-Filmen wie Titanic, The Bodyguard, Pirates of the Caribbean, Braveheart und Moulin Rouge, geschrieben von bedeutenden Komponisten wie John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Horner und Klaus Badelt. (Special, Music) - 2024-10-19

classica.us.title: Tschaikowski - Sinfonie Nr. 2, Op. 17
classica.us.description: Sir John Eliot Gardiner leitet das Orchester del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in einem Konzertprogramm, das Pjotr Iljitsch Tschaikowskys Symphonie Nr. 2 in c-Moll, op. 17, "Kleiner Russe", enthält. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2025-05-31

classica.us.title: Preludes - Tänze am Klavier
classica.us.description: "Preludes - Tänze am Klavier" ist ein multidisziplinäres Projekt, in dem Tanz und Musik zusammenkommen. Diese Aufführung, choreografiert von Massimo Morricone, wurde am 25. Juli 2023 im Teatro Romano di Verona, Italien, aufgezeichnet. (Special) - 2024-05-15

classica.us.title: Neun Sinfonien verändern die Welt
classica.us.description: Der Filmemacher Michael Waldmann besuchte das West-Eastern Divan Orchestra während der Proben in Spanien und schloss sich den Touren nach Südkorea und China an. (Special, Music) - 2019-01-11

classica.us.title: Donizetti: Don Pasquale
classica.us.description: Aus dem Teatro Filarmonico di Verona: "Don Pasquale" von Gaetano Donizetti (1797-1848). Musikalische Leitung: Omer Meir Wellber - Inszenierung: Antonio Albanese. Mit Simone Alaimo (Don Pasquale), Mario Cassi (Malatesta), Irina Lungu (Norina), Francesco Demuro (Ernesto). Zum großen Missfallen seines Onkels Don Pasquale hat Ernesto sich in die junge Witwe Norina verliebt. Auf Doktor Malatestas Rat gibt Norina sich als dessen Schwester Sofronia aus und umwirbt Don Pasquale. (Special, Opera, Comedy, Music) - 2014-01-15

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Klaviersonate Nr. 21 - III
classica.us.description: Julijana Sarac spielt den dritten Satz aus Ludwig van Beethovens Klaviersonate Nr. 21. (Special, Music) - 2023-05-02

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: IVC 2019 - Finale: Haydn, Schubert et al
classica.us.description: Die Sendung präsentiert das Halbfinale des internationalen Gesangswettbewerbs von 2019. Diesmal treten die Mezzosopranistin Ema Nikolovska aus Kanada und der Pianist Michael Sikich aus den Vereinigten Staaten an. Sie präsentieren verschiedene Stücke. (Music, Classical) - 2023-04-03

classica.us.title: Bach - 4. Brandenburgisches Konzert
classica.us.description: J. S. Bachs sechs Brandenburgische Konzerte gehören zu seinen bekanntesten Werken. Bei dieser Aufführung im Spiegelsaal des Köthener Schlosses präsentieren Luks und sein Collegium 1704 Bachs Brandenburgisches Konzert Nr. 4 in G-Dur. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-06-11

classica.us.title: Shusha Renaissance
classica.us.description: Die Stadt Schuscha wird oft als Wiege der aserbaidschanischen Musik und Poesie und als eines der wichtigsten Zentren der aserbaidschanischen Kultur angesehen. Im Januar 2021 wurde sie zur Kulturhauptstadt Aserbaidschans erklärt. (Special, Music) - 2025-03-03

classica.us.title: Bach - Partita Nr. 2 und Sonate Nr. 3
classica.us.description: Die Geigerin Isabelle Faust spielt zwei Solowerke für die Violine von J. S. Bach: Partita Nr. 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 und Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. Beide Werke sind Teil der bekannten Sonaten und Solo-Partiten für die Violine des Komponisten. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2023-04-21

classica.us.title: Clara Haskil - Das Geheimnis der Interpretin
classica.us.description: Für Freunde und Musiker war und ist die Schweizer Klaviervirtuosin Clara Haskil eine Interpretin, die wie keine andere Maßstäbe gesetzt hat. Anhand von Klaviereinspielungen, Briefen und Interviews zeigt der Film die Musikerin in neuem Licht. (Special, Documentary, Biography, Art) - 2017-08-27

classica.us.title: Mozart - Klaviersonate Nr. 13, KV 333
classica.us.description: Roberto Prosseda spielt Mozarts 5. Klaviersonate und vier Impromptus von Franz Schubert. Prosseda bringt das Konzert mit einer Interpretation der technisch anspruchsvollen Ballade Nr. 4, Op. 52 von Chopin zu einem krönenden Abschluss. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2021-02-19

classica.us.title: Modena: The Belcanto School
classica.us.description: Der Film zeigt Opernsänger während ihrer Ausbildung und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung in der Region Modena. Die Oper hat dort eine lange Tradition und Kultur und nirgendwo sonst gibt es eine so hohe Dichte an Opernhäusern wie in der Provinz Modena. (Special, Documentary, Opera, Performing arts) - 2021-04-01

classica.us.title: Beethoven Egmont Ouverture, Tsjaikovski Symfonie 4
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Nicolás Pasquet leitet das Orquesta Sinfónica Freixenet der Reina Sofía. Auf dem Programm steht die Egmont-Ouvertüre von Ludwig van Beethoven, Op. 84 und Pjotr Iljitsch Tschaikowskis Sinfonie Nr. 4 in f-Moll, Op. 36. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-12-16

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Klavierkonzert Nr. 1
classica.us.description: Martha Argerich spielt Ludwig van Beethovens Klavierkonzert Nr. 1 und die Sinfonie Nr. 2 in D-Dur. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-07-02

classica.us.title: Roberto Giordano spielt Brahms und Beethoven
classica.us.description: In seinem Konzert spielt Robert Giordano Brahms' Sechs Klavierstücke, op. 118 und zwei Sonaten von Beethoven: die berühmte Mondscheinsonate Nr. 14, op. 27 Nr. 2 und Nr. 31, op. 110, die eine spätere Sonate des Komponisten ist. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2018-09-12

classica.us.title: Werke von Beethoven und Saint-Saëns

classica.us.title: Veerhavenconcert 2016
classica.us.description: Das Veerhavenconcert ist eine jährliche Veranstaltung im Hafen von Rotterdam. Diese Aufnahme stammt vom 27. August 2016. Es spielt die Sinfonia Rotterdam unter der Leitung von Conrad van Alphen. Solisten sind dieses Mal Maria Warenberg (Mezzosopran) und Melle de Vries (Cello). Auf einer schwimmenden Bühne zeigen Spitzenmusiker dem Publikum auf den Booten im Hafen oder auf dem Kai, was sie können. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert)

classica.us.title: Bach - Brandenburgischen Konzerte, BWV 1046-1051

classica.us.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartett Nr. 4, Op. 18, Nr. 4

itvmeridian.uk.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland - North Donegal
itvmeridian.uk.description: Dermot travels to Letterkenny in Donegal, often called Ireland's 'forgotten county', but quickly discovers a place full of unforgettable people, stories and food. Surrounded by ancient rainforest, he heads into the woods to forage for prized golden chanterelle mushrooms before visiting the renowned Lemon Tree Restaurant, where he learns to make tortellini completely from scratch with one of Donegal's most skilled chefs. (Cookery, Travel) - 2026

itvmeridian.uk.title: Gary Barlow's Food and Wine Tour: New Zealand - Hawkes Bay
itvmeridian.uk.description: Gary Barlow and Jason Manford arrive in Hawke's Bay for the final leg of their New Zealand journey. In Napier, Jason surprises Gary with a classic car tour through the city's famous Art Deco streets, before they feed rescued koror?, New Zealand's tiny blue penguins, at the National Aquarium. Before sunrise, they join an autumn equinox gathering at ?tea a Rangi, a moment rooted in M?ori tradition and well worth getting up early for.

10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E4 Safari Pals Kai-lan discovers some mysterious footprints, so there's only one thing to do - lead her friends on a safari through the backyard to find out who made them!

10shakeperth.au.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E22 Rainy Day Banana Gabby, Pandy and CatRat inexplicably find a sparkly banana on a rainy day.

10shakeperth.au.title: Rubble and Crew (Double Episode)
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E7 The Crew Builds Charger A Super Bed / The Crew Builds A Super Squirrely Whirly Playground Charger has a problem... he's got too much energy to sleep! Rubble & Crew know there's always a construction solution. // Rubble and the pups build the coolest Super Squirrely Whirly playdate ever!

10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E4 Mission PAW: Quest for the Crown Ryder launches a rescue mission after Chase goes missing at Barkingburg Castle, while the Princess' pup, Sweetie, steals the royal crown.

10shakeperth.au.description: S4 E5 Pups Save A Sleepover / Pups Save The Carnival Farmer Al's animals go missing during a sleepover. Cornelius has escaped from the pig ride at the carnival, and the prizes have gone missing too!

10shakeperth.au.title: Henry Danger
10shakeperth.au.description: S5 E16 I Dream Of Danger When Charlotte has a dream where she nearly kisses Kid Danger, she actively tries to avoid Henry for fear of the dream coming true.

10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E4 Mommy's Masterpiece/a Thief Among Us! Gargamel's Mother poses for Painter's masterpiece. // When the Smurfs' favourite things start disappearing all over the Village, everyone gets worried & suspicious.

10shakeperth.au.title: Pig Goat Banana Cricket
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E6 Prank Thy Neighbor The gang gets new neighbours, the Hamshanks! Banana vows to prank them away. Goat becomes infected and slowly turns into a Hamshank. Pig falls in love the youngest Hamshank.

10shakeperth.au.title: Wylde Pak
10shakeperth.au.description: S2 E6 Prison Break / Canyon Valley Film Festival When Jack and Lil are grounded by Will and Min, the family team up to escape their punishment. // Canyon Valley hosts a festival and Jack's excited to enter.

10shakeperth.au.title: Wylde Pak

10shakeperth.au.title: Tyler Perry's Young Dylan

10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E9 Mother May I Dylan writes a serious rap about his mom. Martin to read his diary to find out if he's doing ok. Dylan catches him, triggering an escalating run of each family member invading the others' privacy.

10shakeperth.au.title: Tales Of The TMNT
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E12 The Pearl The East River 3 are on the verge of victory! The Turtles and Mutanimals must team up to stop them, but not everything is as it seems... what is the PEARL and why does Goldfin want it?

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E1 Help Wanted/reef Blowers/tea At The Treedome SpongeBob finally applies for a job at the Krusty Krab. // SpongeBob finds the perfect use for his high-powered reef blower. // SpongeBob meets Sandy Cheeks for the first time.

10shakeperth.au.title: SpongeBob SquarePants

10shakeperth.au.description: S1 E3 Jellyfishing/plankton While Squidward recovers from a bicycle accident, SpongeBob and Patrick takes him jelly fishing. // SpongeBob falls victim to a scheme by the evil Plankton.

10shakeperth.au.description: S38 E24 Sterling And Nina Agdal Lviii On an all-new episode of Ridiculousness, Rob, Steelo, and Nina Agdal get out their bats and hit some WHIFFLE MISSILES and slam in their VR headsets in CRASHING INTO REALITY.

10shakeperth.au.title: Have You Been Paying Attention?

abcmelbourne.au.title: Weekend Breakfast - Sunday 4 October 2026
abcmelbourne.au.description: All the news you need to start your Sunday. Fauziah Ibrahim and Luke Siddham Dundon bring you the latest news, interviews, politics, culture, weather and global affairs. Plus sport with Daniela Intili. (News)

abcmelbourne.au.title: Insiders
abcmelbourne.au.description: Start your Sunday morning with the show the politicians rely on to find out what's going on. David Speers presents Australia's must-watch political program, joined by a panel of the best political analysts and commentators. (News)

abcmelbourne.au.title: Offsiders - NRL and NRLW Grand Final Special
abcmelbourne.au.description: The Roosters are the first team through to the NRL Grand Final, against the winner of Penrith v Newcastle. Abbey Gelmi and the panel preview the action ahead of the NRL and NRLW Grand Finals. Plus the Socceroos and Wallabies. (Sports)

abcmelbourne.au.title: The World This Week - Sunday 4 October 2026
abcmelbourne.au.description: Girish Sawlani brings you a weekly roundup of international news from an Australian perspective as reported by ABC News correspondents covering the Indo Pacific, Europe, North America, the Middle East, India and Indonesia. (News)

abcmelbourne.au.title: Compass - Surviving Gaza, Seeking Truth
abcmelbourne.au.description: In this highly personal story, Palestinian Australian journalist Patrick Abboud connects with Palestinian journalists now living in Australia, including Sameh, a camera operator who has lost family members in Gaza. (Special Interest)

abcmelbourne.au.title: Songs of Praise - 200 Years of the RSPCA
abcmelbourne.au.description: To celebrate the RSPCA's 200th anniversary, Rev. Kate Bottley visits an animal hospital in Birmingham. In the cat ward, Kate meets the charity's CEO Chris Sherwood to hear the remarkable story of how the RSPCA was founded. (Music)

abcmelbourne.au.title: ABC News At Noon - Sunday 4 October 2026
abcmelbourne.au.description: Pablo Vinales presents the latest from ABC News on the weekend bringing you today's top stories and coverage of events as they unfold. Plus original reporting, analysis and updated news, sport, weather and information. (News)

abcmelbourne.au.title: Landline
abcmelbourne.au.description: Hosted by award-winning journalist Pip Courtney, Landline is Australia's only national agricultural television program covering stories from Australia's rural and regional heartland. (Special Interest)

abcmelbourne.au.title: Gardening Australia - Artists' Gardens: Creativity with Plants
abcmelbourne.au.description: Costa explores the garden at the Australian National Gallery and we visit the gardens of artist Ralph Bristow, bookshop owner and artist Alexander Okenyo, mixed-media artist Jasmine Jan and miniaturist Natasha Bieniek. (Special Interest)

abcmelbourne.au.title: Portrait Artist Of The Year
abcmelbourne.au.description: The six artists compete head-to-head in the semi-final, painting their own unique renditions of ARIA award winning singer Marcia Hines. The top three artists of today will move forward into the final. (Special Interest)

abcmelbourne.au.title: Grand Designs: House Of The Year - Materials And Craftsmanship
abcmelbourne.au.description: Kevin McCloud, Damion Burrows and Natasha Huq explore homes showcasing outstanding materials and craftsmanship, from Brecon Beacons sandstone to weathering steel. (Special Interest)

abcmelbourne.au.title: Creative Types With Virginia Trioli - Jenny Kee
abcmelbourne.au.description: Jenny Kee is one of our most original and recognisable creatives. Over four decades her exuberant designs defined modern Australia. In what she says will be her last interview, she reflects on her vast legacy. (Special Interest)

abcmelbourne.au.title: Amanda & Alan's Italian Job - Tower Room & Cellar

abcmelbourne.au.title: Take 5 - Genesis Owusu

abcmelbourne.au.title: Back Roads - Gulf Country, NT
